title: 第1035章 胡海的推断第1034章 三人小组讨论霍安2
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 柳文说道：“这倒是没有什么，反正我们几个都在，或者让胡海重新掌握环宇帝朝，暂时帮我解决这个问题。”
吴浩说道：“我就想知道，胡海现在到底在想什么，从我们的人收集的情报来看，胡海现在几乎什么都不做，
他现在只是待着，并没有任何动作，现在环宇帝朝的事情，都是我们安排的人在做。”
柳文说道：“你都安排人了，胡海还能看不出来吗？他自然知道，我们是不信任他的，
所以现在所有的事情，他都是不参与的，他想要的，只是安稳的过渡，不想让自己处在危险的边缘。”
老于说道：“关于胡海，你们有什么想法？”
柳文说道：“我觉得胡海那个人，是可以用的，能在贾昂身边潜伏那么久，后面脱身的时候，
还能逼着贾昂将自己放在那个位置上的人，是有些手段的，而且他一直都是我们自己的人，
我觉得可以培养，但是要和他好好谈一谈。”
吴浩说道：“我们和他谈，是不是有些浪费时间了，让安亮他们谈就好，他们不是薛英柏的人吗？
让薛英柏谈也可以了，不至于我们出面吧？”
老于说道：“这件事，还是要我们几个定，如果可以，我们在环宇帝朝，就不用花费那么多心思了，
胡海能解决，我们必须确定好这件事，才能为我们之后的发展，提供依据。”
柳文说道：“那我现在安排人，通知他过来，见一见。”
老于点了点头，说道：“嗯，尽快吧，我们现在缺的就是时间了。”
柳文点了点头，没有再说什么，而是立刻安排人去通知胡海了，让胡海尽快赶过来。
很快胡海便来了，胡海不知道他们找他干什么，但是他心中大概也明白，三人小组的人，
安排了自己的人在环宇帝朝，而自己，就是他们掌控环宇帝朝最大的障碍，这次叫他来，具体是为了什么，
心中也大概有了答案。
当胡海走了进来的时候，老于先开口说道：“你就是胡海？”
胡海点了点头，说道：“见过三位老祖。”
柳文说道：“谈不上什么老祖，今天叫你来，没有别的意思，就是想问问你，关于环宇帝朝，
那些天策楼遗留下来的人，现在是什么样子。”
胡海一听，说道：“现在天策楼的人，和霍安关系近的人，都已经处理差不多了，剩下的，
都是之前天策楼的人，我没有清理，那些人能力不错，在不同的城池，做城主，而且效率很高，
至于他们现在到底是什么样子，我也说不清楚，最近我已经不关注他们了。”
吴浩说道：“那些人，可以信任吗？”
胡海说道：“这个我就不知道了，这件事，还是要你们去查的。”
老于说道：“那如果还是你来做环宇帝朝的皇帝，你会重用他们吗？”
胡海说道：“谈不上重用，我会用，城主这个位置，已经可以了，没有什么比这个位置高的职位给他们了，
content_en:
Liu Wen said: "It's nothing. Anyway, we are all here, or let Hu Hai regain control of the Huanyu Imperial Dynasty and help me solve this problem temporarily."
Wu Hao said: "I just want to know what Hu Hai is thinking about now. Judging from the intelligence collected by our people, Hu Hai is doing almost nothing now.
He is just staying there and not taking any action. The affairs of the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty are all done by the people we arranged. "
Liu Wen said: "You have arranged people, how can Hu Hai still not see it? He naturally knows that we do not trust him,
So he is not involved in everything now. What he wants is a smooth transition and does not want to put himself on the edge of danger. "
Lao Yu said: "What do you think about Hu Hai?"
Liu Wen said: "I think Hu Hai can be used. He can lurk next to Jia Ang for so long. When he escapes later,
The person who can still force Jia Ang to put himself in that position has some tricks, and he has always been one of our own,
I think it can be cultivated, but you need to have a good talk with him. "
Wu Hao said: "It's a waste of time for us to talk to him. Just let An Liang and the others talk. Aren't they Xue Yingbai's people?
It’s okay to let Xue Yingbai talk, and we won’t have to come forward, right? "
Lao Yu said: "This matter still requires us to make some decisions. If we can, we in the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty will not have to spend so much thought.
Hu Hai can solve it, but we must determine this matter to provide a basis for our future development. "
Liu Wen said: "Then I will arrange for someone to come over and meet him."
Lao Yu nodded and said, "Well, as soon as possible, what we are short of now is time."
Liu Wen nodded and said nothing more. Instead, he immediately arranged for someone to notify Hu Hai and asked him to come over as soon as possible.
Soon Hu Hai came. Hu Hai didn't know what they were looking for, but he probably understood in his heart that the people in the three-person team,
They have arranged for their own people to be in the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty, and they are the biggest obstacle to their control of the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty. What is the specific reason for calling him here this time?
I probably have the answer in my mind.
When Hu Hai walked in, Lao Yuxian said, "Are you Hu Hai?"
Hu Hai nodded and said, "I have met three ancestors."
Liu Wen said: "I can't talk about any ancestors. I have no other intention of calling you here today. I just want to ask you about the Huanyu Emperor Dynasty.
What are the people left behind in Tiance Tower like now. "
Upon hearing this, Hu Hai said: "Now the people in Tiance Tower and those close to Huo An have been dealt with almost, and the rest are...
They were all people from Tiance Building before. I didn’t clean them up. Those people were very capable and served as city lords in different cities, and they were very efficient.
As for what they are like now, I can't tell. I have stopped paying attention to them recently. "
Wu Hao said: "Can those people be trusted?"
Hu Hai said: "I don't know about this. You still need to investigate this matter."
Lao Yu said: "Then if you are still the emperor of the Huanyu Dynasty, will you reuse them?"
Hu Hai said: "Let's not talk about reuse. I will use it. The position of city lord is enough. There is no higher position for them.
